“表妹，你先放开赵妍。”戚明雪温柔的出声。

戚明雪对外的形象一直是温柔善良，所以就算赵妍这么不客气的吼她，她也没表现出任何的恼怒。

时笙眸子转了转，无辜的看着戚明雪，“表姐，不是你说要教训一下她的吗？我”

戚明雪脸色一变，“表妹，你胡说什么，我之前都不知道你在这里……”

“戚明雪！”赵妍的尖叫打断了戚明雪，脸色铁青，“你还有什么话说？我就知道你不安好心，在宋大哥面前装模作样，你个不要脸的女人……”

赵妍越骂越大声，戚明雪的解释都被她盖了过去。

赵妍在这里，就是之前和赵景因为戚明雪的事，闹了矛盾，这才一气之下，带着和她关系比较好几个妹纸到了这里。

本就和戚明雪有矛盾，此时听到时笙随口胡诌的一句，她哪里还有理智去思考。

“傻叉！”

时笙骂了一声，不过赵妍骂得太起劲，并没有听到。时笙无趣的将铁剑收了回来，退回了三楼门口，扬着下巴对着常新道：“常队长，做人要讲信用，你的人若是在靠近这里，就别怪我这把剑要开封血祭了。”

常新：“……”还开封血祭，这妹纸是中二病吧？

戚明雪眼睁睁的看着时笙将门关上，赵妍没了束缚，顿时朝着戚明雪扑了过来。

场面立即混乱不堪，拉架的拉架，劝解的劝解，但是最后还是发展成了一场女人的战争。

戚明雪被赵妍的人拉着抓了好几下脸和脖子，最后离开的时候，戚明雪看上格外的狼狈。

回到营地，宋拾还没睡下，见戚明雪那狼狈的样子，神色微变。

“怎么了？”宋拾迎上去，刚才出去的时候还好好的，怎么回来就弄得这么狼狈？

戚明雪眼眶微红，“没事，就是遇到表妹了。”

“她还活着？”宋拾有些诧异，那天她突然就不见了，他本以为她早就死了，谁知道她还活着。

想到那个女人，他就有些不舒服。

“嗯，我本想让她和我们一起，谁知道她竟然冤枉我，离间我和赵妍……”戚明雪的声音很低，透着无尽的委屈。

不需要添油加醋，当时的事说出来也足以让宋拾更加的厌恶时笙。

戚明雪见宋拾眼底的厌恶，微微松口气，她是看过全文的，知道顾南身为女主有多大的魅力，宋拾这个男人虽然不在文里，但是难保他不会被顾南的女主光环所吸引。

戚明雪以为时笙是女主，可其实她现在才是真正的女主。

时笙回到三楼，目光闪了闪，觉得有些不对劲，她往窗户那边看去，之前还蹲在那里的未来丧尸皇不见了！

"Cousin, let go of Zhao Yan first." Qi Mingxue said softly.

Qi Mingxue's external image has always been gentle and kind, so even if Zhao Yan yelled at her so rudely, she didn't show any anger.

Shi Sheng rolled his eyes and looked at Qi Mingxue innocently, "Cousin, didn't you say you wanted to teach her a lesson? Me"

Qi Mingxue's expression changed, "Cousin, what are you talking about? I didn't even know you were here before..."

"Qi Mingxue!" Zhao Yan's scream interrupted Qi Mingxue, her face was ashen, "What else do you have to say? I know you are not well-intentioned and are pretending to be in front of Brother Song, you shameless woman..."

Zhao Yan cursed louder and louder, and Qi Mingxue's explanations were drowned out by her.

Zhao Yan is here because she and Zhao Jing had a conflict before about Qi Mingxue, so she got angry and brought several girls who were close to her here.

She already had conflicts with Qi Mingxue, but when she heard Shi Sheng's casual remarks, she had no reason to think.

"Silly!"

Shi Sheng cursed, but Zhao Yan was too enthusiastic and didn't hear it.Shi Sheng took the iron sword back boredly and returned to the door of the third floor. He raised his chin and said to Chang Xin: "Captain Chang, you have to be trustworthy. If your people are close to here, don't blame me for unsealing this sword for blood sacrifice."

Chang Xin: "..." He also performed a blood sacrifice in Kaifeng. Is this girl suffering from the second disease?

Qi Mingxue watched helplessly as Shi Sheng closed the door. Zhao Yan lost her restraints and immediately rushed towards Qi Mingxue.

The scene immediately became chaotic, with arguments and persuasion, but in the end it developed into a women's war.

Qi Mingxue was pulled by Zhao Yan's people and scratched several times on the face and neck. When she finally left, Qi Mingxue looked particularly embarrassed.

Back at the camp, Song Shi had not yet fallen asleep, and his expression changed slightly when he saw Qi Mingxue's embarrassed look.

"What's wrong?" Song Shi greeted him. He was fine when he went out. Why was he in such a mess when he came back?

Qi Mingxue's eyes were slightly red, "It's okay, I just met my cousin."

"She's still alive?" Song Shi was a little surprised. She suddenly disappeared that day. He thought she had died long ago, but who knew she was still alive.

Thinking of that woman, he felt a little uncomfortable.

"Well, I originally wanted her to be with us, but who knew she would wrongly accuse me and drive a wedge between me and Zhao Yan..." Qi Mingxue's voice was low, revealing endless grievances.

There is no need to add fuel to the fire, telling what happened at that time was enough to make Song Shi hate Shi Sheng even more.

Seeing the disgust in Song Shi's eyes, Qi Mingxue breathed a sigh of relief. She had read the whole story and knew how attractive Gu Nan was as the heroine. Although Song Shi was not in the story, there was no guarantee that he would not be attracted by Gu Nan's aura as the heroine.

Qi Mingxue thought Shi Sheng was the heroine, but in fact she is the real heroine now.

When Shi Sheng returned to the third floor, her eyes flickered and she felt something was wrong. She looked towards the window and saw that the future zombie king who was squatting there before was gone!
